simple.meaning: דָּשֵׁן (dâshên) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “fat ; figuratively, rich , fertile.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Psalms, Isaiah, beginning at Psalms 22:30. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דָּשֵׁן (H1879).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: דָּשֵׁן (dâshên) / H1879 is traced through Psalms 22:30, Psalms 92:15, Isaiah 30:23 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: to show that Yahweh is upright.
He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.

definitions.full: H1879. dashen דָּשֵׁן adjective fat , דָּשֵׁן Isa 30:23 (|| שָׁמֵן ), of לֶחֶם as product of ground; figurative of righteous as trees דְּשֵׁנִים Psa 92:15 (|| רעננים ) fat, full of oil (?) or sap (Che; compare דֶּשֶׁן Judg 9:9 ); as substantive vigorous, stalwart ones (opposed to עָפָר יוֺרְדֵי compare Che) Psa 22:30 אֶרֶץ דִּשְׁנֵיֿ (Brüll שֹׁכְנֵי , Ren Hist. iii. 134 ישְׁבֵי ).
